notes.title: Steam Deck Verified (Hauntii Newsletter 2)
notes.notes:
[h2]Steam Deck Verification[/h2]
It finally happened - Hauntii is verified for Steam Deck! It's always been optimized to play well on Steam Deck, but there were a few minor issues preventing it from being verified until now. 

[h2]New Build[/h2]
While preparing a new build for Steam Deck, we also added a number of minor fixes and tweaks. These are mostly audio improvements and a few bug fixes. [b]Version 5.4.16[/b]

[h2]Independent Games Festival[/h2]
We were so happy to see that Hauntii won the Excellence in Visual Art award at IGF this year! Thank you judges that is awesome. We've added the badge to to the store page : )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/5ceb01947912a1487236bcec1b9ab568b9997b6a.png[/img]

[h2]Gamescom Latam[/h2]
And finally, we have a booth currently at Gamescom Latam in Brazil! If you saw us there leave a comment hehe.
We're grateful to have received four award nominations from Brazil Independent Games Festival!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/1fc3a7b6355118cc7e017922b30afefd3df66a9c.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming[/h2]
Next up in the works for Hauntii are some improvements for mouse & keyboard input. I'm aware there are some hauntables that have a frustrating experience with this control scheme [spoiler](I'm lookin at you, sandwhales)[/spoiler]

Thanks for reading, until next time!
-MOONLOOP

notes.title: Hauntii Nominated for Best Soundtrack
notes.notes:
[i]Golden Joystick[/i] has selected Hauntii as one of the nominees for [b]Best Soundtrack[/b]!

I'm pretty biased about this and of course I think Hauntii deserves to win. Our composer, Michael Kirby Ward, absolutely poured his soul into the music, as did our live performers. Hauntii has live music for many of the tracks and a full performance by the Lyris Quartet for the ending theme. But ultimately it's about the end result - If you feel that Hauntii deserves to win best soundtrack, vote to help us out!

The website is a bit confusing so I added steps below:
[h3]Step 1[/h3]
[url=https://www.gamesradar.com/goldenjoystickawards/]Click here to begin voting[/url] and scroll down until you see the 'start voting' button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/b20a19f03be5c2a6ca27ede0c6264a4762396514.png[/img]

[h3]Step 2[/h3]
Vote or skip until you get to the [b]Best Soundtrack[/b] category.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/57773a960abe0eb4f3f501b115a6d19297231d50.png[/img]

[h3]Step 3[/h3]
Click this button to vote! But that won't submit yet, be sure to complete step 4!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/81b604189f41fdd890f025933663ffa24e370326.png[/img]

[h3]Step 4[/h3]
Continue through the categories until the end, then click this button to submit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/328d3a4f9adce493b5408f967fcfeab2b97ef8c6.png[/img]

And that's it! We really appreciate if you're able to take a few minutes to support our little team and game. Hauntii is going up against some pretty heavy hitters ( Final Fantasy 7???) and obviously we don't have the resources of Square Enix, but with a strong community presence we can still win this!

Thanks again for playing Hauntii and for reading this message.

Sincerely,
-Leo

notes.title: Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
Welcome, new souls!

It's now been just over a month since Hauntii's release, and we've been overwhelmed by the sincere love and support we've had from this community. It honestly makes our day every time someone rocks up in our Discord to share their 100% achievement run, so feel free to keep those coming 👻

To mark the occasion, we're matching our launch discount in the Steam Summer Sale - the game is 20% off from now until 11th July.

And that's not all - we've updated the game's original demo with a brand new [b]save data transfer[/b] system, which will let new souls try out the demo and then carry over their progress to the full game to explore the rest of Eternia.

For full details please check the Steam demo post in our forum, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2060790/discussions/0/4418675885158195550/]here[/url]. If you've already played Hauntii, we'd love it if you shared the demo with your friends.

If you'd like to join our community to hunt down missing stars, share fan art, or philosophize about the meaning of life, you can join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/j9CSYQvECZ]here[/url].

Now, we'd better get out of here before Sporeo starts taking chunks out of this post...

Lots of love,
Moonloop Games & Firestoke

notes.title: Steam Cloud Now Integrated
notes.notes:
Yep you heard right, Steam Cloud is now implemented for Hauntii! You can now seamlessly move between your different PCs and Steam Deck. 

[i]One thing to note: we don't support save-on-suspend, so be sure that you don't have Hauntii running on two or more systems at the same time in order to prevent conflicts. [/i]

[h3]In the works:[/h3]
In other news, there's a few great updates in the works and coming to you soon. We're currently testing the next build, but it will have the following updates. 
[list]
[*]add an option in the crystal menu for unequipping your hat
[*]add missing hats

notes.title: Hauntii is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/da85f8ec23d3f9847f8c5e5a7985c67bb3095c37.png[/img]

The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that [b]Hauntii [/b]is finally out today (yay!), and to celebrate, you can glide into this hauntingly beautiful world with a 20% launch discount.

Hauntii brings a fresh and creative haunting mechanic that lets you possess the environment and the creatures around you. Whether it's enemies, rocks, trees, or even bugs, you can take control and use their special abilities to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and navigate through the enchanting world of Eternity.

As you embark on this adventure, you'll encounter a cast of charming characters, each with their own unique personalities and insights into the game’s mythology. The game seamlessly blends minimalist storytelling, action, and discovery with twin-stick shooter mechanics, all set to a dynamic soundΩtrack by Michael Kirby Ward that perfectly complements the on-screen action.

Hauntii is set in the mysterious realm of Eternity, a place beyond space where all souls eventually end up. In Eternity, no ghost can truly die, but they can become corrupted into hellish versions of themselves. Guided by the enigmatic Eternians, glowing creatures that lead lost souls to a central tower, you'll unravel the mysteries of this ethereal world. Who are the Eternians? What secrets does the tower hold? And what will you discover about your own past?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/490adb2916481a8cbeb8e3be02a76e42757f778d.png[/img]

We can’t wait for you to experience the magic and mystery of Hauntii. Let us know your thoughts and share your adventures with us in the community!

We also want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you – our amazing community, fans, and everyone who has joined us on this incredible journey. Your support and enthusiasm have made this possible, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Thank you for being a part of the Hauntii adventure!

Happy haunting! 
Leo, Michael and the Firestoke Team.

LudoNarraCon is the perfect platform to showcase narrative-driven games, and we're honoured to be featured alongside other amazing titles. It's a testament to the hard work and dedication of our team here at Firestoke and Moonloop Games, and we couldn't be more proud of Hauntii's journey so far.

Look at our [url=https://youtu.be/cXbqSssuvuo]shiny new trailer[/url], please like it?

We are happy to announce that Hauntii is also going to be a part of the official [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MFgG_ayRwK8]Steam Next Fest Livestream[/url] alongside other amazing games! It's your chance to catch a glimpse of not just Hauntii, but a curated collection of diverse games participating in Next Fest!

We've also got Hauntii's developers, Leo and Michael, streaming the Hauntii demo and guiding us through the ghostly landscapes. Catch the stream on the Hauntii store page!

We're really excited for you to play the demo. Hauntii is more than just a game to us, it's an emotional experience and we hope you enjoy it. We'd love to know your thoughts and feedback!

Thanks so much for all the support!
Firestoke and Moonloop Games
